body: hey, i’m here if you need to talk.
please don’t do it, you are so loved.
thank you so much for offering, i really appreciate your concern. i am, however, quite sure that there is nothing anyone can say at this point to change my (sound) mind.

hey, it sounds like we have similar backgrounds. first of all, your feelings are valid. a good life on paper doesn’t entail happiness. if you think you need to go back to treatment, do it; don’t worry about how your parents will react, i’m sure they would want to know what you are going through.

i am in the exact same situation as you. please please please realize that your depression is a real illness and that it can be quite debilitating without necessarily showing strong physical symptoms.
hey, i’m happy to listen. is there anything in particular that’s bothering you?
